title: Shopping starts with AI and demand is cautious: make our store agent-ready
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery (NIQ); Google launched Universal Cart; Newegg added Google UCP checkout; Amex and Glance/PayPal launched agent checkout. Q3 PC shipments fell over 20%; NRF sees 4.2% holiday growth.

points.headline: AI discovery and agent checkout are arriving together
points.detail: NIQ: 55% use AI in discovery; Shopify says AI discovery converts better; Google Universal Cart, Newegg UCP, Amex and Glance/PayPal enable agent buying. Our feeds and checkout must be agent-ready.

points.headline: PC demand is weak while memory costs rise
points.detail: Global PC shipments fell more than 20% in Q3 (DigiTimes) and AI data center demand keeps DRAM and NAND prices rising into Q4. We should plan holiday stock and pricing carefully.

points.headline: Holiday spending grows but shoppers start earlier and stay selective
points.detail: NRF forecasts 4.2% growth and Adobe $275.1B online sales; Deloitte says 28% of budgets are spent by end of October. We should bring tech deals forward.

points.headline: Small businesses and Gen Z are growing buyer groups
points.detail: Capital One finds small businesses cautious but ready to grow, and nearly half of SMBs want digital payments; Gen Z games 9+ hours a week. We should target both with tailored offers and payments.
